notes: Total 165 pieces including the sticker sheet (b27), matching the parts list. Every type count was checked against the inventory.

The booklet really builds three separate models: red car (page 3-4), delivery truck (page 5-7) and the store (page 8-36). The last page shows them standing side by side, not attached to each other. The red car shares no pieces or joins with the others, so it is correctly its own group. The truck and the store are linked only through the shared sticker sheet (b27). The two remaining groups are therefore intentional, not a missing connection.

The truck is built upside-down in the booklet (blue plate first, then black, then clear, then flipped). rests_on is given for the finished upright truck: blue plate b11 sits on the black pieces, which sit on the clear pieces, so b11 refers to later ids.
Each 4081b clip plate holds two black round-plate wheels by their studs (clip joins). Wheels clutch nothing, so their rests_on is [].
No positions were given in the booklet, so position is null. Many rests_on lists for the store are best estimates from the isometric drawings (which plate or brick sits under which), not exact.
Tiles (3069b, 3070b, 2431, 63864, 87079) have no studs, so nothing rests on them.
The 2nd 4x10 black plate (b37) is assumed to sit on the first (b28).
Stack sub-assemblies (yellow on 2 clear plates x3, 3-clear stacks x2, red/clear/clear/tile stack, silver round stack) are listed bottom to top.
The lamp post is b163 (black round plate) -> b165 (support 1x1x1 2/3) -> b164 (clear round plate). I assumed it stands on green plate b56.
The sticker sheet is joined to the truck side (b21) and the sign tile (b162) as sticker applications.
